headline: A realistic weight-transfer EV drift racer in a single HTML file
text:
We built a physics-accurate EV drift game in a single HTML file.

Grip is a budget. Weight transfer initiates oversteer. Regen braking keeps you alive.

0.1s load, zero ads, 100% open-source:
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced 5-second gameplay GIF: hitting the brakes into a high-speed snowy turn, weight shifting sideways into a clean countersteered drift with battery sparks, then dodging a zombie bounty.
